title: Neural-network solution of subtracted three-body Faddeev integral equations near the Efimov limit
summary: We apply a deep-neural-network (DNN) ansatz to the symmetrized spectator vector of the subtracted three-body Faddeev integral equation for identical bosons near the Efimov limit. The network is trained by minimizing the residual of the discretized integral equation, while the positive binding scale associated with the three-body energy is treated as a trainable parameter. Deterministic diagonalization of the same discretized kernel is used only as an a posteriori numerical benchmark.
